reason: I already paid for a DM tool that got me almost no replies and an action block, so anything that sends Instagram DMs makes me nervous. A card-required trial that bills on day 4 with no refunds, and no customer results anywhere, feels like a trap to me.
objection: Three days isn't enough to see replies from cold DMs, and day 4 is when it charges $147 with no refund. I'd be paying before I know if it works or if my account is safe, and there's not a single customer result to go on.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from people at my size, plus a refund window of 14 days or more (or a trial long enough to actually get replies without a card up front).
